'''2001 Mirkwood Team Tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG team tournament held in 2001 with 12 teams.<ref name="dt-17016">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/17016 He's Back], DeckTech (Karim "kjedi" Jetha, 25 June 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/17016/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/17016/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 23 June 2001<ref name="tr-d2540" />
* '''Site:''' Minnesota<ref name="dt-16863">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16863 A Place for My Head], DeckTech (Karim "kjedi" Jetha, 20 June 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16863/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16863/ GitHub Pages].</ref>; Mirkwood Coffee & Comics, Minnesota<ref name="tr-d2514" />
* '''Type:''' team tournament
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' X-SAC (team: [[Michael Raveling]], [[Jim Li]], [[Zach Stenerson]])<ref name="tr-d2514" />
The event is known from a DeckTech post of 25 June 2001; the posts give no date, exact site or winner; a later post calls it "the Mirkwood team tourney in Minnesota". It was played before [[Coruscant (expansion)|Coruscant]] was tournament legal.

Jetha went 2–1 with his Dark deck, winning by 33 and 35 and losing one game by about 15; his team finished 11th of 12.<ref name="dt-17016" />
